This is equivalent to finding a Ramsey (3,3) coloring on 5 vertices. Indeed, the unique (up to isomorphism) such coloring is the 5-cycle: color edges of a 5-cycle red, and the complementary edges (the other 5-cycle) blue. That yields no monochromatic triangle.
